summary.description: two to five sentences: what this pass did and what it means

next.description: what happens at the next pass and when (the pass runs at :45 every hour)

waiting.description: what waits on an approval, a grace period or a person, with the row ids (#id)

left_alone.description: the notable skips and why, grouped by reason, not one line per resource

concerns.description: anything that looks wrong: errors, a module that stopped proposing, a saving claim that looks off; empty when nothing does

sphinx.description: the 3 to 6 line message to post in the team chat: plain text, no markdown, under 900 characters
